gen-gf-unkempt-gf-albert-sans: Expressive and a little bossy, Unkempt lays down its wobbly pen-drawn letters up top, while Albert Sans keeps its apertures open even at tiny sizes. Their strongest quality is how different they are.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-alef: Rough, hand-pushed letters at the top. Alef follows in open-ended curves that read as modern and clean, and the lines keep moving without snagging or tiring the eye.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: A stylus-at-fixed-pressure line gives Unkempt its scrappy, hand-made look, set against the open, welcoming gap in the c of Alegreya Sans SC. The two split the work cleanly.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-amarna: Unkempt brings a commanding, hand-drawn energy, with a t whose crossbar and stem match in weight, over the contrast-free strokes of Amarna. Loud above, tidy below.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-andika: That t with a crossbar and stem of matching weight gives Unkempt its blunt, marker-like confidence, and Andika answers with tails and terminals as thick as its stems. Give the heading extra size.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-anta: Anta looks like bent wire, with gaping mouths on the e and constant thickness throughout. Unkempt is the one that shouts with expressive swagger, while Anta is the one that keeps quietly approachable.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-antic: Scrappy up top, tidy below. Antic keeps a drawn-with-one-nib look with open letter mouths, so a longer read moves along smoothly beneath the loud heading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ar-one-sans: Unkempt carries the same visual mass in every part of its letters, giving it a blunt, hand-cut presence. And AR One Sans, with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, feels light and modern beside it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-assistant: Unkempt is tubular and wire-like, with real presence. Assistant sits next to it quietly, its mouths staying open on c, e, and a, so the two feel loud and plain in turn.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-asta-sans: Asta Sans draws tubelike, constant-weight lines, and its e is never mistaken for a blot. And beneath Unkempt's commanding hand-made heading, a longer passage would feel approachable and easy to follow.
